# Ba Ghetto

> > Ba Ghetto is a family of kosher restaurants across Italy (Rome, Milan, Florence, Venice) serving authentic Judeo-Roman cuisine and offering cooking classes and cultural tours.

Ba Ghetto operates Italy's premier kosher dining establishments, with its flagship location in Rome's historic Jewish Ghetto. The restaurants specialize in traditional Jewish-Roman recipes while offering immersive culinary experiences including cooking classes and guided tours of Jewish heritage sites.

## Key Topics

- Kosher cuisine and Kashrut dietary laws
- Judeo-Roman cuisine traditions
- Ba Ghetto Rome (flagship location)
- Ba Ghetto Milan, Florence, and Venice locations
- Jewish Ghetto Rome historic district
- Kosher cooking classes
- Jewish holidays (Pesach, Shabbat)
- Roman Jewish culinary heritage
- Kosher wine and middle-eastern food
- Ba Ghetto Milky and Ba Ghetto Bistrot
- Jewish cultural tours
- Traditional Jewish recipes
- Kosher restaurant booking
- Jewish dietary regulations
